verses.1: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign as king of Israel, Jeroboam became king over Judah. He built the Tower of Shechem, so that no one could go up or come down to Asa, the king of Israel.
verses.2: And Assa took gold and silver from the treasures of the House of God and from the palace of the king. He sent them to Ahaziah, the king of Aram, who ruled in Damascus.
verses.3: A covenant between me and you, and between my father and your father. Now, I have sent you gold and silver as a gift in accordance with this covenant. You shall take the throne of Israel from the king of Israel, and it shall be yours.
verses.4: And Benhadad heard of King Asa’s plan. He sent his soldiers to the cities of Israel. They attacked Jezreel, Dan, and Avshalim. They also destroyed all the cities of Naphtali.
verses.5: And when he heard the noise, he stopped building the tower. He then ceased his work.
verses.6: And Asa, the king, took away all of the Jews. He carried off the stones from the ruins and the pegs that were made from them. With those stones, he built the walls and the city walls.
verses.7: And on that day, Hanani came to Asa, king of Judah. He said to him, “Why do you support King Aram? Why don’t you support Yahweh your God? For that reason, the army of King Aram will be defeated by you.”
verses.8: The chariots and horses were used as vehicles for many people, and also as mounts for soldiers. They were given into your hands in order to serve you, O LORD.
verses.9: For Jehovah’s eyes are upon all the earth, so that He can strengthen them with His love. But they have been deceived by this; for from now on, there will be wars among you.
verses.10: And Asa became angry with the Lord. He handed him over to the house of destruction, because he was angry with him for this reason. And Asa fled from among the people at that time.
verses.11: And behold, the words of Asa, the first and second kings, are written in the book of kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.12: And Asa reigned for thirty-five years. During his reign, he walked on his feet until he reached the top of the hill. And even while he was sick, he did not seek help from Jehovah, because he believed that he would be healed.
verses.13: And Asa lay down with his fathers. He died at the age of forty-one years as king.
verses.14: And he was buried in his own grave, which had been prepared for him in the city of David. He was laid in a bed made of precious materials, with spices and fragrant oils. Then he was burned at the great fire, over and over again.
